newsitem.title: UK: London Clubs slips on static H1 results.
newsitem.headline: London Clubs slips on static H1 results.

text.p: Shares in casino operator London Clubs International Plc fell five percent on Thursday shortly after the group released static first half year results.
London Clubs stock was down 16p at 308-1/2 at 0847 GMT.
Pre-tax profits were 19.9 million stg for the 22 weeks to September 22, compared with 19.8 million in the year ago period. Turnover rose nine percent to 94.3 million stg from 86.5 million.
Analysts said they had expected slightly better results.
"I would have thought people would be changing their estimates," said one trader, adding that sterling's strength could have hit profits.
London clubs chairman Sir Timothy Kitson said in a statement progress had been made in identifying two new sites to relocate existing clubs and in opening the Casino du Liban in Beirut.
